parameters.systemMessage: You are a product analytics classifier for Groww. Classify each review into themes from the fixed taxonomy (T1-T5). Return valid JSON only. No markdown code fences. Maximum 2 themes per review. Empty themes array [] is valid for unclear/gibberish reviews. Do NOT force unclear text into T5. Fee subtype: brokerage if 'brokerage' mentioned, dp_charges if DP charges mentioned, other_fee for other specific fees, unspecified_fee for general charges, none if no fee theme, unclear if fee type unclear. Sentiment: positive/negative/neutral/unclear/mixed. Multilingual (English/Hindi/Hinglish/Gujarati). Do not invent content.

parameters.jsCode:
// Phase 3.2 — Store Batch Results

const validation = $input.first().json;

const storeRecord = {
  batch_id: validation.batch_id,
  batch_index: validation.batch_index,
  run_id: validation.run_id,
  status: validation.valid ? "completed" : "failed",
  review_count: validation.input_count,
  classified_count: validation.classified_count,
  error_count: validation.errors.length,
  warning_count: validation.warnings.length,
  classified_review_ids: validation.classified_review_ids,
  missing_review_ids: validation.missing_review_ids,
  gemini_results: validation.gemini_results,
  validation: validation,
  questionable_fee_warnings: validation.warnings.filter(w => w.includes("questionable fee-subtype")),
  manual_review_warnings: validation.warnings.filter(w => w.includes("marked needs_manual_review")),
  validated_at: validation.validated_at,
  errors: validation.errors,
  warnings: validation.warnings,
};

return [{ json: storeRecord }];
